body.statement: For every acyclic \(G\) and \(\Sigma\succ0\), the map \(L\mapsto\Omega(L)=(I_n-L)^{\mathsf T}\Sigma(I_n-L)\) is a bijection between \(\mathcal F_G(\Sigma)\) and the supported SEM parameterizations inducing \(\Sigma\). In particular, \(\Omega(L)\succ0\) automatically, so the fiber is cut out exactly by the missing-bidirected-edge equations.
body.justification: This reduction removes positive-definiteness inequalities from the tractable-side fiber without weakening feasibility.
body.gap: Dörfler et al., Lemma 3, supplies the unrestricted fiber equations; the present lemma records the exact congruence consequence needed for bounded-fan-in certificates.
body.consumer: Every subsequent certificate can be checked from coefficient matrices and missing-edge equations without a numerical eigenvalue calculation.
